notes.title: VOID ZOMBIES UPDATE
notes.content:
Thank you so much for the continued support! Today I am excited to share the newest update that I have been working on. Along with a major re-haul of the [b]MAGE[/b] Class - including 6 new abilities with special care taken to the feel and usability of the class. 

[b]MAGE[/b] has been given it's first 6 skills which represent the default build which the mage will come with post alpha. During alpha each class will have only a default build and through alpha into beta more skills will be added to the skill tree for each class. Eventually the plan is to have 24 skills for each character including a set of global skills which can be used with any class. 

[b]GLOBAL DODGE[/b] has been added which will activate when and direction key is pressed twice. 

[b]VOID ZOMBIES[/b] game mode has been added. Below are detail:

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
In this minor update I have added the ability to choose a class.

-Created classes and Class/Character are now chosen in the main menu, before entering a game.
-Included classes are: Mage, Warloc, Warrior, Shaman, Rogue, Cleric

In the future you will be able to level up your characters, unlock new skills, change your build and skins. 

Please note that all classes are works in progress and they will be getting significantly more unique and interesting with upcoming updates. 

Currently there are 24 skills in the game and that will be doubled in and update later this month.

I am very open to people's suggestions for both new classes as well as new abilities (or edits to existing).

If you are here this early in the development, THANK YOU! You are amazing!

tags.feature: -Created classes and Class/Character are now chosen in the main menu, before entering a game.
-Included classes are: Mage, Warloc, Warrior, Shaman, Rogue, Cleric

notes.title: July Major Update
notes.content:
I am very happy to announce that the final patch of [b]alpha season 1 [/b]has been uploaded. 

I have gotten an amazing response and have been more than glad to provide daily updates and testing to get things up to par with what would be considered a "working game" 

Today's patch includes the final piece of the puzzle in the form of full prediction for projectiles so no matter what the latency state, the game will feel smooth.

The next update will be the start of alpha season 2 and I will make a big announcement about the first ever Void Arena Tournament that I will be hosting. 

Thank you for checking this out and WELCOME TO VOID ARENA! 

@sad_gandalf

tags.feature: Today's patch includes the final piece of the puzzle in the form of full prediction for projectiles so no matter what the latency state, the game will feel smooth.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
-Increased the peripheral range of melee attacks by more than double
-Normalized the damage done by melee attacks
-Increased the health of the HEART OF EARTH from 500 to 1000
-Attempted to fix a bug which caused Soul Barrage to stop working if cast during the dying animation
-The timer in the end screen will no longer jump around
-The weak points of the HEART OF EARTH will now disappear at the end of the round
-An issue preventing players from receiving gold if they died during a round has now been fixed
-Players will now be reset before the first round
-Alignment issues found in the end game UI have been fixed
-When creating a standard match, options will now be available to customize the match
-When a WEAK POINT for the HEART OF EARTH spawns, it will start to flash after 5 seconds if it is not struck it will explode, healing the HEART OF EARTH for 200 HP
-In-game chat has now been added to both STANDARD and HORDE game modes
-Cancel target binding has now been fixed in the settings menu

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
-Destroying a single HEART OF EARTH will now win the round
-Temporary sounds are now added to all minions while they are idling in HORDE mode
-Fey will now shoot their void orbs upwards when a player is out of reach
-Soul barrage now gains resource when firing
-Ping is now being shown in the player's HUD as well as in the join a session menu
-An issue was fixed that prevented the player from gaining gold when completing a wave in HORDE mode
-Non server players will no longer have an intense screen shake when missing with melee attacks
-Player footsteps sounds are now significantly louder
-Effect announcements will no longer be cut off in the player's HUD
-Legacy gear and weapons will no longer drop in HORDE mode
-Gold is now shown in the player's HUD
-A crash involving spinning enemies has been identified and they have been temporarily removed from the game
-STANDARD matches have had their total rounds reduced to 4 from 10 before switching sides and the winning condition has been reduced from 11 rounds to 5 rounds
-A mini game has now been added which makes destroying a Heart of Earth more engaging (weak points will now appear when striking a HEART OF EARTH
-Pressing escape will now close the buying menu in addition to pressing B

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Clicking escape will now make all menus close
[*] Menu buttons had some tiling issues that are now fixed
[*] After the end of a round, players' current character will be destroyed and a new one will be assigned -- this was done to easily reset health, mana and stamina between rounds
[*] Kill streak UI placement has been adjusted
[*] Further fixing of sound attenuations
[*] Players new to the game will have their name and stats updated upon joining 
[*] Leaving players will no longer cause an issue in the score board
[*] Collisions preventing player traversal through the middle of Ban Yokai have been removed
[/list]

notes.title: Updated Demo Released
notes.content:
The first iteration of VOID ARENA's new direction is now released as a demo on our page. 

In this demo you will be able to try out both STANDARD and HORDE game modes. 

VOID ARENA is being created by a single developer who really needs your help to test the systems. 

24 Abilities are included in the demo and community suggestions are encouraged for creating new and interesting abilities. 

1 Map is included in the demo (Ban Yokai)

[b]Upcoming updates:  [/b]

[list]
[*]Hidden Stores
[*]Gear/weapon purchase and Upgrade
[*]New Abilities
[*]Map Variations
[/list]

Thank you for checking this out and WELCOME TO VOID ARENA! 

@sad_gandalf
